question: In which of the following groups of the periodic table is the metallic element 'silver' found?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Group 11**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Silver** is found in **Group 11** of the periodic table.
 
• Group 11 is also known as the **coinage metals group**, which includes copper (Cu), silver (Ag), and gold (Au).
